name: codegraph
description: CodeGraph semantic code intelligence for Codex: pre-indexed local code knowledge graph with auto sync.

interface.shortDescription: Local code knowledge graph for faster, more precise code answers.
interface.longDescription: Wraps the CodeGraph CLI (github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph): indexes a repository into a local knowledge graph that auto-syncs on code changes, and guides Codex to query it instead of grepping, reducing tokens and tool calls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use codegraph to answer questions about this repository.
